title: MoreFood MITE
description: 50+ new MITE food items like new crops, fruits, cooked items, fast food, desserts, snacks, and more
body:
## What items have been added to this mod ?
**(The following foods are not given a specific value to prevent excessive penetration.)**

- **horse meat and cooked horse meat**. Kill the horse to get
- **Various soups**. Made from fruit or crops
- **Fried Egg**. Raw eggs are finally useful
- **Various meat nugget**.Cut meat with a dagger
- **Squid meat and squid whiskers**. Kill them to get meat while being carefully dragged into the water
- **Flame gold apples and ancient metal apples.** After eating, a strong potion effect is obtained
- **Various fruit snacks and baking products**.

More food awaits you to explore.
